name: Clever Ropework
body:
With a length of rope, chain, or a whip, you can restrict your foe’s movement.

Benefit(s): As a standard action you may make a melee touch attack against a target within 15 ft as long as you are holding a similar length of rope, chain, or a whip. If this touch attack succeeds you move adjacent to your target and wrap your rope around their legs, rendering the target entangled. The target can still move and may free themselves as normal using Escape Artist or making a Strength check to burst their bonds as normal for whatever material is binding them such as when they have been ensnared in a net.
